## Custom GUI Mod v1.1.6

This release extracts GUI geometry and colors into dedicated classes while preserving the v1.1.5 layout, scaling calculations and palette. A middle-click awakening regression was subsequently identified and fixed in v1.1.7.

### Added

- Added `GuiLayout` for the logical 1280×669 canvas, panel and rune-grid geometry, navigation anchoring, purchase animation origin and pointer coordinate conversion.
- Added `GuiTheme` containing the existing 45 GUI palette values.
- Added `guiLayoutRegression` to the standard Gradle `check` and CI workflow.
- Added 10 viewport fixtures captured from v1.1.5, covering scaling, coordinate rounding, navigation, repeated resizing and all 26 rune click targets.

### Fixed

- No gameplay fixes are introduced in this release; it reorganizes layout and theme responsibilities.

### Other

- Updated screen rendering and click-coordinate conversion to use a shared layout instance.
- Removed unused legacy GUI bounds and limits.
- Kept server/MongoDB logic, packet commands, fonts, textures and blur implementation unchanged.
- Passed the local clean build, inventory/layout regression checks and feature, develop, main and tag CI builds.
- Verified the published JAR and version metadata; packaged assets match v1.1.5 byte-for-byte.
- README screenshots remain explicitly labelled v1.1.4.
- **Known issue:** the separate awakening event handler still reflected grid fields removed from `CardsGuiScreen`, preventing middle-click awakening. The geometry tests did not cover this event-handler dependency. Use [v1.1.7](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/releases/tag/v1.1.7) for the fix; its awakening behavior was confirmed in Minecraft by the user.

### Download

The attached artifact is `customguimod-1.1.6.jar`. For working middle-click awakening, install [v1.1.7](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/releases/tag/v1.1.7) instead. The client and server must use the same mod version.

Required resource pack:
[RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0)

Choose either:

- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-64x64.zip`
- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-128x128.zip`

**Full Changelog:** [v1.1.5...v1.1.6](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.1.5...v1.1.6)
